name: Virtual TV
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
overview: Virtual linear TV channels inside Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Virtual TV 1.0.0 first official full release for Jellyfin 12.1. The Jellyfin technical package version is 1.0.0.0 to match the assembly version. Includes Standard TV and Personalized TV, Sequential/Random/weighted True Random scheduling, Next Unwatched and Random Unwatched, resume-first behavior, per-user visibility, Content Coverage, compact channel management actions, and per-channel configuration import/export. Import/export copies configuration fields only and does not copy artwork or schedules.
